paragraphs: On Saturday morning, Tom and Lily walk with Pip on the town street. A man stands at the corner and looks at a paper. It is Teacher Nick, Tom's new teacher. The sun is hot, and the street is busy. "Excuse me," he says, "where is the library?" "I am new in town, and I don't know the way." Tom thinks. "Go along this road," he says. "Then go down to the square." "Turn left at the café." Lily says, "The library has a blue door." Teacher Nick looks at his paper again.

"Shall I show you?" asks Tom. "Yes, please," says Teacher Nick. "Thanks, Tom!" They walk along the road. Lily has Pip's red ball. They see the bus station on the left. Many buses stop there. Teacher Nick says that the town is very big. People get on the buses, and some people get off. Then they go down to the square. Pip sees something in the café. He runs into the café by mistake. "Pip, come back!" shouts Lily. A woman in the café laughs. Tom takes Pip out of the café.

Now they turn left at the café. They can see a blue door. "That's the library!" says Lily. Teacher Nick looks at the door and smiles. Pip looks at the door and says, "Woof!" "Now I know the way," says Teacher Nick. "Thanks, Tom and Lily!" He goes into the library and takes a book about football. Tom is happy, and Pip is happy too.
text.summary: Teacher Nick is new in town and asks the way to the library. Tom gives directions, and Pip runs into the café by mistake.
